item.title: OfiLibre coffee shops are back!
item.description: Next Wednesday, September 11th Cafes con OfiLibre are back! We’ll start the academic year talking about our upcoming plans, how you can stay informed about what we’re doing, and which initiatives the University is preparing regarding open access, free culture, and all the topics we care about at OfiLibre.
